concerns.text: The plan cites 'OpenNeuro (ds004xxx)' with a HuggingFace URL pointing to 'openneuro-fslr64k' (a structural fMRI dataset). The research question requires electrophysiology (spike counts) and behavioral logs. ds004xxx is a placeholder, and the provided URL resolves to a structural MRI dataset, not the required neural/behavioral multimodal data. The dataset is inappropriate for the question.

The plan assumes 'Up to 50 subjects, 10 training days per subject, ~500 units per day' without citing a source. While empirical counts are deferred, the feasibility of the CPU-first constraint (2 cores, 7 GB RAM) depends on the actual scale of the cited dataset. If the real dataset exceeds this scale (e.g., high-density Neuropixels data), the planned compute model is infeasible. The plan must cite the specific dataset to validate the scale assumption.
